# 9. Implementation Bridge

## 9.0 Device Mapping

Map each major narrative element to MUD devices. This is the abstraction layer between story and implementation.

### Device Reference

**Static Devices** (YAML definitions):
- Room, NPC Prototype, Item Prototype, Dialogue Tree, Quest

**Dynamic Devices** (Script-powered):
- Behavior Script (NPC patterns, schedules)
- Event Script (triggered occurrences, public gatherings)
- Atmospheric Script (environmental effects, mood changes)
- World-Mod Script (room description changes, spawning)
- Trigger Script (on-enter, on-examine, conditional)

# 10. Validation & Audit

Run these checks before marking design complete.

## 10.1 Thread Lifecycle Audit

Every thread must have: Plant → Develop → Payoff

| Thread | Planted (Beat) | Developed (Beats) | Paid Off (Beat) | Status |
|--------|----------------|-------------------|-----------------|--------|
| | | | | ✅ / ⚠️ / ❌ |
| | | | | |
| | | | | |

**Status Key:**
- ✅ Complete - Full lifecycle (3+ touchpoints)
- ⚠️ Partial - Missing development OR weak payoff
- ❌ Orphaned - Planted but never paid off, OR paid off without planting

## 10.2 Side Quest → Main Story Integration

Critical emotional arcs should NOT be optional:

| Character | Main Story Presence | Side Quest Arc | Integration Status |
|-----------|--------------------|--------------|--------------------|
| | | | ✅ Main story sufficient / ⚠️ Add main beat |
| | | | |

> **Rule**: If a character's arc is primarily in side content, add at least ONE main story beat acknowledging their journey.

## 10.3 Causality Validation

| Question | Answer | Evidence (Beat #) |
|----------|--------|-------------------|
| Why is the crisis happening NOW? | | |
| Why this character for the sacrifice? | | |
| What determines success vs. failure? | | |
| Why didn't earlier attempts succeed? | | |

## 10.4 Character Consistency Check

| Character | Established Trait | Potential Contradiction | Resolved? |
|-----------|------------------|------------------------|-----------|
| | | | |
| | | | |

## 10.5 Timeline Consistency

| Event | When | Characters Present | Lifespan Issues? |
|-------|------|-------------------|------------------|
| | | | |
| | | | |

## 10.6 Open Questions (To Resolve)

Track unresolved narrative questions:

| Question | Priority | Notes |
|----------|----------|-------|
| | High/Med/Low | |
| | | |

## 10.7 Pre-Implementation Checklist

- [ ] All threads have complete lifecycle (10.1)
- [ ] No character arcs locked behind optional content (10.2)
- [ ] All causality questions answered (10.3)
- [ ] No character contradictions (10.4)
- [ ] Timeline is consistent (10.5)
- [ ] All high-priority questions resolved (10.6)
- [ ] Philosophy failure modes explained (3.4)
- [ ] Character lifespans justified (5.1)
